 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[red bold]-- CHANNEL ERROR -- channel_zero.volt:3[/red bold]

Channel `data` capacity must be at least 1.

 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]3 |[/dim] channel data: int[0]
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]        ^^^^[/red]

[cyan]Hint: Example: `channel data: int[8]`[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- CHANNEL WARNING -- channel_zero.volt:3[/yellow bold]

Channel `data` is sent to but never consumed (no receive/has_data call).

 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]3 |[/dim] channel data: int[0]
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Add `data.receive()` or `on data.has_data()` in a task to process the data.[/cyan]
